This part of the manual describes what the desk expects

Companion Animal Travel Desk - Arrival Handling
Purpose: This section sets the standard for calm, safe, and respectful service for pets and their travelers at Aurelia Skyways.

Staff must greet every traveler in a steady, reassuring manner and keep the work area quiet and orderly. Handlers should use gentle, humane methods at all times, and they must not rush a pet or handle it roughly, even when the lobby is busy. If a pet shows fear or distress, staff should lower stimulation, speak softly, and request support from the senior coordinator when needed.

Check-in records must be complete before acceptance continues. <<FACT F092>> Documents should be reviewed with care, and any mismatch in carrier details, traveler identification, or animal health information must be raised at once. Staff should explain next steps in plain words, without speculation, and should avoid giving comfort that cannot be supported by the record.

The desk also keeps travelers informed when a pet needs additional attention, while preserving privacy and dignity. Peanut, if present, must be treated with the same calm standard as any other traveling animal. When special handling is required, staff should follow approved guidance and keep the chain of responsibility clear. A traveler may remain nearby when that helps the animal settle, provided the area stays safe and uncluttered.

The senior coordinator makes the final daily service decision when circumstances are unclear, and staff should escalate promptly instead of guessing. For any unresolved concern, contact the senior coordinator through the usual service channel.
